new_hypothesis.name: buyer_diversity_velocity_divergence
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Among bonding-curve tokens with IDENTICAL SOL-raise velocity, the ones with a high distinct-buyer ratio (distinct_buyer_wallets / buy_trade_count over the first 5 min) outperform low-ratio tokens on 10-30 min forward return. High ratio = a real crowd is forming; low ratio = one or a few wallets (bundler/sniper cluster) are faking the velocity. Velocity alone is necessary but spoofable; the second-order diversity ratio separates organic acceleration from manufactured acceleration.
new_hypothesis.persistence: The cheap PumpPortal websocket exposes raw velocity (vSolInBondingCurve, marketCapSol) to every sniper, so velocity-only edges get crowded out fast. Wallet-diversity is a SECOND-ORDER computation (you must dedupe traderPublicKey across the trade stream and ratio it against trade count) that most snipers skip - and in the current sub-1% graduation regime, genuine crowd formation is the scarce, high-information ingredient while bundled velocity mean-reverts within minutes. The edge lives in the computation gap, not the data gap.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase-1 LOG-ONLY (no trades). For each new pump.fun mint, over its first 5 minutes compute (a) velocity = SOL-raised-per-minute = [vSolInBondingCurve(t=5m) - vSolInBondingCurve(t0)] / 5, and (b) diversity_ratio = distinct buy-side traderPublicKey / buy_trade_count. Flag 'hot' tokens whose 5-min velocity is in the trailing-24h top decile, and for every flagged token log diversity_ratio at flag time plus forward return at +10m and +30m and a graduated_bool/time_to_graduation. After ~2-4 weeks of logging, test whether high-diversity flagged tokens beat low-diversity flagged tokens at equal velocity. Only then consider a live entry rule (e.g. enter flagged tokens with diversity_ratio above the learned cutoff).
new_hypothesis.data_required: PumpPortal websocket wss://pumpportal.fun/api/data: subscribeNewToken (FREE, enrolls every new mint at t0) + subscribeTokenTrade for the flagged cohort (each trade event carries mint, traderPublicKey, SOL amount, vSolInBondingCurve, marketCapSol - progress and buyer identity both readable off the stream, no extra RPC). subscribeTokenTrade meters at ~0.01 SOL/10k events and caps ~100 mints/call, so cap the watched cohort. Free fallback for backfill: Bitquery GraphQL DEXTrades(ProtocolName:'pump') exposes count and count(distinct: Transaction_Signer, if: buy).
new_hypothesis.evidence: Launchpad scout (2026-06-07, real web calls): graduation rates collapsed below 1% platform-wide since ~May 22 (pump.fun 0.80%, LaunchLab 0.31%, Boop 0.14% - beincrypto), which sharpens the thesis: when <1% graduate, an abnormally-fast token is a rarer, higher-information event. pump.fun re-took #1 by mints/traders/graduates after letsBONK's collapse (The Block), so the bot's existing pump.fun grad-listener is correctly weighted to host this. pump.fun graduation completes at ~85 SOL raised / ~$69k mcap; progress = 100 - leftTokens*100/initialRealTokenReserves (Bitquery bonding-curve API). The existing graduation websocket already subscribes to this program - extending it to read per-token swap velocity + buyer diversity is incremental, not new infrastructure.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: REQ-023's heterogeneous net-buy-book WC loss class has a CLEAN 2-feature separator. Walked all 21 lifetime WC trades (9W/12L). Gate: SKIP WC entry if pair_age_hours > 30 AND (price_change_1h > 25 OR price_change_24h < -10). Plain English: on an AGED token (>30h) skip it if it's either showing a fresh 1h pump (an aged coin going vertical = exit liquidity / late pump) OR already bleeding on the day (distribution). The age>30h arm is the key: it spares the genuinely-young pumped winners (Butt +17.43 age5h, TIMETRUMP +1.20 age2h, WINNING +1.15 age16h) while catching the aged pumped/bleeding losers. This is COMPLEMENTARY to (not overlapping) the already-shipped REQ-021 gate (age>=1700h AND net-sell book), which catches SQUIRE-L; the two gates' blocked sets are DISJOINT.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: wallet_convergence all_time N=21 WR 42.9% R/R 0.55 pnl -0.01614 SOL avg_win 5.75% avg_loss -10.5% PF 0.36 (sol_strategy_stats.json). rolling_7d N=6 1W/5L WR 16.7% R/R 2.13 pnl -0.010255 PF 0.43. The 12 lifetime losses include the three seed dumps HUNTER -28.40, HENRY -17.03, BURNIE -9.59.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: On the 21-trade sample the gate blocks 6 of 12 losses (HUNTER -28.40, HENRY -17.03, BURNIE -9.59, KINS -1.37, CWU -0.24, JTVO 0.00 = -56.63% of return) and ZERO of 9 wins, moving the sample from 9W/12L to 9W/6L. Projected: WR 42.9% -> ~60%, R/R 0.55 -> ~1.1+, all_time pnl -0.01614 -> roughly -0.005 SOL (the HUNTER -0.008963 SOL loss alone is removed). Forward-going it should remove the largest WC tail losses while leaving win-rate of fired trades intact.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: Revert if, after activation, the gate blocks >=2 entries that (counterfactually, via logged would-have features) would have been WINS, OR if WC rolling-10-trade R/R falls below 0.40 with the gate live.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: Evaluate at N=8 WC fires post-activation (WC fires ~2-4x/wk -> ~3-4 weeks). Gate is zero-cost on the 21-trade win set, so it can ship before N is large.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY (both mechanisms - aged-token going vertical = late/exit pump, aged-token already bleeding = active distribution - are regime-independent; all three seeds were observed in CHOP/ALTCOIN_CHOP).
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Remove the single WC entry skip condition (pair_age_hours>30 AND (h1>25 OR h24<-10)); revert to prior WC entry logic (CWC-veto + REQ-021 aged-net-sell gate only).
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case it silently blocks a rare aged token that pumps and keeps running, or an aged bleeder that V-reverses. At N=21 it blocks 0 historical wins and the aged-pump/aged-bleed cohort contributed zero WC wins, so expected foregone profit ~0; realistic downside is one missed marginal flat-win (~+0.5%) every few weeks.

COUNTERPOINT: this gate targets a DIFFERENT, currently-UNHANDLED loss class (it catches HUNTER/HENRY/BURNIE which none of the 3 pending gates catch - verified disjoint from REQ-021's SQUIRE-L), and is zero-cost on wins, so shipping it together with a restart is defensible.
